::: {.hero}
[Julius Welzel · Cognitive neuroscientist]{.kicker}

# Movement, mobile EEG and open science {.unlisted}

[Research on the cortical control of gait and on movement disorders, using mobile EEG, motion capture and wearable sensors.]{.dek}
:::

::: {.hero-figure .reveal}
![](images/eeg.jpg){fig-alt="Black-and-white photograph of an EEG cap with electrodes and cables on a mannequin head"}
:::

::: {.home-grid}
::: {.dropcap}
I am a postdoctoral researcher with two equal part-time positions: in the [Neuropsychology Lab](https://uol.de/en/neuropsychologie) (Stefan Debener) at the University of Oldenburg and in the [Neurogeriatrics group](https://neurogeriatrics-kiel.com/de/team-de/) (Walter Maetzler) at Kiel University. My research addresses the cortical contribution to gait and how it changes in movement disorders such as Parkinson's disease and essential tremor.

Methodologically, I combine mobile EEG with motion capture, EMG and wearable sensors during walking. I also work on the infrastructure for such recordings: the [Motion-BIDS](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modality-specific-files/motion.html) data standard, open-source software such as [KielMAT](software/index.qmd#kielmat), and the reporting and preprocessing of mobile EEG studies.

For collaborations or thesis projects, please [contact me by email](mailto:julius.welzel@gmail.com).
:::
